question: Calculate the total number of wickets taken by each bowler (excluding run-outs and other dismissals not attributed to the bowler), their economy rate (total runs conceded divided by total overs bowled, considering only runs scored off the bat and ignoring any extra runs like wides and no-balls), their strike rate (average number of balls bowled per wicket taken), and their best bowling performance in a single match (the match with the most wickets taken by the bowler, formatted as "wickets-runs" where runs are the runs conceded excluding extras).
sql:
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_balls_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id, bb.innings_no
),
bowler_balls_runs_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        SUM(balls_bowled) as total_balls,
        SUM(runs_conceded) as total_runs
    FROM bowler_balls_runs
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wt.kind_out IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wickets_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt 
        ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
best_match AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        wickets_in_match,
        runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY wickets_in_match DESC) as rn
    FROM bowler_per_match
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    ROUND((1.0 * bra.total_runs / bra.total_balls) * 6, 2) as economy_rate,
    ROUND((1.0 * bra.total_balls / bw.wickets_taken), 2) as strike_rate,
    bm.match_id,
    bm.wickets_in_match || '-' || bm.runs_conceded as best_match_performance
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN bowler_balls_runs_agg bra ON bw.bowler = bra.bowler
JOIN best_match bm ON bw.bowler = bm.bowler AND bm.rn = 1
WHERE bw.wickets_taken > 0
ORDER BY bw.wickets_taken DESC
